title: Harvest Vegetable Donations
description: Bring vegetables such as carrots, cabbages, broccoli, small pumpkins and leeks for the Harvest learning topic. We will only need a few of each vegetable for each class.

title: Bring Kitchen Roll Tube for Telescopes
description: Children to bring in a kitchen roll tube to make their own telescopes

title: Bring Baby Photo for R.E Lesson
description: Children to bring in a photo of them as a baby for R.E lesson (physical copy to be returned or upload to Tapestry)

title: Bring Cut Fruit for Fruit Kebabs
description: Children to bring in cut up fruit (two or three types) in a labelled pot to make fruit kebabs linked to repeating patterns learning

title: World Space Week - Bring Space Themed Items
description: Children can bring space themed items (e.g. small world, rockets, books) during the week - items should be labelled with child's name

title: Coat Donation - good quality unwanted coats
description:
This November, our school will be supporting Wrap Up London, which collects warm coats to help people in need. Since 2011, over 250,000 warm coats have been donated.

The 2026 collection will run from 2 to 20 November. If you have any unwanted coats in good condition, please send them in to school by Friday 20 November.

Donation boxes will be available in the entrance hall for you to drop off your coats. Please make sure any children's names are removed from coats.

title: Bring in Egg Box
description: Please bring in a 12-egg box; will be using each row of 6 to make a caterpillar

title: Comfy for a Cause Pyjama Day
description: We will be supporting the Help for Hunger charity this year by taking part in their Comfy for a Cause pyjama day on the 27 November. More info to follow.

title: Bring in small world birds
description: If children have any small world birds/soft toy birds, it would be great if they could bring these in. Please can they be labelled with your child's name.
